name: Aoi Yuuta
source:
The younger twin of the two, Yuuta is far calmer compared to his high-energy brother. However, despite his sunny and sociable disposition, he does still become insecure at times as he grows up. Cherishes Hinata, his older brother, greatly. With a tender, lively singing voice, his performances are out of the ordinary and without restraint.

Part of 2wink under Cosmic Production.
